rules: Five items in each rarity tier from Legendary through Common.
Each rarity has three optional set paths: damage, defense, utility.
Exactly three different pieces of the same rarity are needed for a set bonus.
Common items do not require attunement and must be actively carried or equipped.
Attunement never exceeds three total slots; artifact items and lower-rarity items compete for the same slots.
These are separate from the locked endgame divine treasury.
